text:
Nina Rao: Heads-up: we need a consolidated package for Snowflake Marketplace + Databricks Partner Tile + Qdrant connector for the EU pilot. Target public listing May 28; internal dry-run May 20.
Ethan Park: timeline ok. primary asks: sample Snowpark notebook, a Databricks Unity Catalog sample, and Qdrant schema examples.
Marta Velez: packaging question: do we include full demo dataset or a trimmed 5MB sample? reviewers prefer small samples.
Nina Rao: small sample in package, full dataset in GitHub link. include checksums.
Jon Hargrave: ops note: for hardware partners (Lambda Labs racks) we need a prebuilt quantized model and a compatibility matrix (A100, A10G). Lambda also wants a quick-install Ansible playbook.
Oliver Grant: SI handoff list: BluePeak (integration validation) and NovaTech (pilot SI). Need a 45-min tech walkthrough after dry-run.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace required fields = vendor_name, product_name, support_contact, license_url, regions_supported, deployment_modes, pricing_table. Portal review SLA = 3 business days.
Ethan Park: I'll own Snowpark notebook + Unity Catalog sample. ETA May 15.
Marta Velez: I'll assemble demo assets (hero image, 30s GIF) + package README + checksums. ETA May 14.
Jon Hargrave: I'll produce quantized artifact and ansible playbook; will include manifest.json with signed checksum. ETA May 17.
Oliver Grant: I'll schedule SI kickoff for May 23 and prep the validation checklist (deploy -> ingest -> query -> perf smoke).
Nina Rao: legal check: need to confirm allowed trial wording for EU marketplaces and data residency flags. @marketplace-bot please confirm residency options for EU-only listings.
marketplace-bot: Confirmed. data_residency_options required: [global, eu_only, customer_vpc]. See /marketplace/policies/residency-eu.md
Ethan Park: small snag: Databricks partner tile requires a notebook example that runs on Serverless SQL clusters; will adapt our sample.
Marta Velez: action items recap: Ethan = notebooks + DBX sample (May 15), Marta = assets + README (May 14), Jon = quantized models + Ansible + manifest (May 17), Oliver = SI checklist + kickoff (May 23), Nina = legal escalation for trial/residency (ASAP).
Nina Rao: I'll create the shared checklist doc and invite BluePeak/NovaTech contacts. Drop external emails here.
Oliver Grant: BluePeak PM is sara@bluepeak.io, NovaTech is luke@novatech.com.
Nina Rao: thanks — will update once legal responds. Flag anything urgent in this thread. :white_check_mark:
